conversion: Reorder the PKX container; convert float seconds to 60-Hz integer ticks, map XD clip/wait track kinds to Colosseum and use the native scheduling flags. Retain the original HSD mesh, textures, skeleton bindings and DAT animation tracks.

shiny_variant.description: Swap the native body/belly material lighting colors and shade only the belly's grayscale CMPR map: white body, dark belly, original red eyes. Mesh, other textures, skeleton, animations and alpha are unchanged.
shiny_variant.portrait_conversion: Native blue-gray head, navy neck and lower jaw become white; the native pale triangle around the red iris becomes charcoal, following their 42px source masks. Teeth, mouth, red iris, violet backdrop gaps, black contours and alpha retained.

xd.format: native CI8/RGB5A3; original circular alpha, black interior, complete 36px artwork centered with 3px padding

colosseum.format: native tiled RGBA8; opaque-black normal Dark and white frames

ui_portraits.mask: Transparent/violet backdrop, eight-connected to the original 42px tile boundary; opaque-black matte shared by interface and native faces
